items.title_orig: My little collection. Nearly at 100 CDs.
items.article_text:
33 years old so I grew up in CD and IPod era. My first albums when I was around 10 years old were in CD and I had a Phillips CD portable player. Most of my teenage years were iTunes and iPods sharing an ear buds with mates.
 I stream still, I have tidal, nothing beats it on the move or in the gym. But I have gone back to cd listening at home due to sound quality and ability to be away from your phone. Got myself a second hand Sony discman the same age as me! And I just love plugging in and listening.
 I have tested CD v Tidal and my external dac setup for tidal whilst technically it is better off my phone or computer. The CD sounds better to me. I think it’s the analogue elements of the discman, it sounds more engaging I can’t put my finger on it . I use the line out to an amp to DT 770. L
